sentences.text:
***** 
(Sl No.175) 
Court No. - 78
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 31911 of 2017
Applicant :- Shah Gayas And 3 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar,Vinay Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jawad Tariq Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1. Heard Sri Jawad Tariq, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Arvind Kumar Mishra,
learned A.G.A. for the State.
None appears on behalf of the applicants.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of the charge-sheet no. 16 of 2017 dated 29.07.2017 in Case No. 2060 of 2017 arising out of Case Crime No.
102 of 2015 under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Firozabad , pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division), Firozabad.

Shah Gayas And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62750339/
1 3.

entities.text: Shah Gayas And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel of the applicants submits that in view of the further developments in the case the applicants wish to withdraw the instant application unconditionally.

In connection therewith, an application for withdrawal of the instant application has already been filed by the applicants, which is supported by an affidavit of the applicant no.1.
4.

In view thereof, the application for withdrawal of the instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., is allowed and the proceedings of the instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. are dismissed as withdrawn.

Shubham Arya (Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) 
Shah Gayas And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 July, 2025
